name: blaze-kitchen-backend
description: Production backend for Blaze Kitchen Cloud Kitchen app

scripts.dev: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -ne $conn) { Stop-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -Force }; nodemon server.js"
scripts.dev:clean: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -ne $conn) { Stop-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -Force }; nodemon server.js"
